rules.fallback_policy: Use a table only when the claim has no meaningful geometric relation; use prose only for context, caveats or synthesis.

types.kpi-strip: 2-4 objective opening facts; no causal conclusion
types.dumbbell: two values or two periods where the gap is the argument
types.diverging-bar: positive and negative values around a neutral axis
types.line: same metric across time with explicit period and unit
types.multiline: two comparable series with identical definition and period
types.horizontal-bar: peer or segment comparison with a common unit
types.waterfall: bridge from one financial state to another; every step labeled
types.stacked-bar: composition of revenue, cost, ownership or assets
types.step-line: ownership, policy or event-state changes over time
types.range-band: guidance, estimates or uncertainty range; visibly labeled
types.flow-map: business/industry chain with named actors and money direction
types.risk-matrix: risk likelihood/impact only when both axes have evidence
types.validation-dashboard: 3-5 operating variables and their neutral verification status
